lesson: 修改调度类配置（cron 表达式）后，断言控制器不会补跑更新前的'错过'周期；起算点应取更新时间而非创建时间。
evidence: "earliestTime ... set to the cronjob's creationTimestamp, without taking the updateTimestamp"；以 /close 指向新控制器关闭，评论称仍复现

lesson: CLI 的格式化模板要在每个平台（含 Windows）跑一遍默认输出，防止模板改动只在一个平台被验证。
evidence: maintainer: "Was broken by 96622b2a7d58d74883bc1777d3be171c2b8f2165"

lesson: 用旧版本创建持久化对象（网络/卷）后升级守护进程，断言启动时能对缺失的新字段做迁移而不是类型断言 panic。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/44935 "IpvlanFlag configuration value [not] persisted ... before v23.0.0"
关闭 PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/58279 未合并，评论把原因归于不同 runtime 版本

lesson: 在资源分配后注入'应用分配失败'（如 cgroup cpuset 更新失败），断言分配器状态被回滚、可用资源不减少。
evidence: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/67430 "We should rollback the state to avoid CPU leak"

lesson: 多层并发拉取时让部分层下载失败，断言临时文件全部清理、磁盘占用回到基线。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/14389 "if only some of the downloads succeed, we would not close and delete"

lesson: 同一秒内连续创建多个 checkpoint 并恢复，断言文件名不冲突、每次都能恢复。
evidence: XREF https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/657 "add nanoseconds ... to avoid naming collision"

lesson: 对集群级（非 namespaced）对象配置 Object 指标，断言 HPA 用 RESTMapper 判断作用域并能取到指标。
evidence: "assumes all objects referenced in the Object metrics type are namespaced"；两个关闭 PR 均未合并

lesson: 向调度器提交带非法 label 值的 affinity 的 Pod（绕过校验），断言调度器只拒绝该 Pod 而不崩溃。
evidence: liggitt: "fixed in .../pull/107558, the scheduler no longer panics"

lesson: 解包只含 etc/dnf/ 而缺少 etc/ 父目录条目的层，断言隐式父目录被自动创建。
evidence: go-archive v0.3.1: "create implied parents for directory entries"

lesson: 在容器删除过程中轮询统计接口，断言累积计数回退为 0 时速率不出现溢出的巨大值。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/10652 "stat value might be reported as zero ... extremely large number"

lesson: 在 Unpack=true 路径下拉取多层镜像，统计同时在途的 fetch 数，断言不超过 MaxConcurrentDownloads。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/6109 "MaxConcurrentDownloads is not effect when Unpack is true"
"We should introduce a buffer ... to the log file output backend"（功能/性能改进）

lesson: 在节点同网段主机把 127.0.0.1 路由到节点，断言 localhost-only 端口不可达（route_localnet 不放行未在 conntrack 中的包）。
evidence: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/91569 "blindly setting route_localnet is too permissive"

lesson: 让一个已注册 readiness 的插件在初始化中失败（如只读 /etc），断言守护进程仍完成启动并发出 READY，而不是永久等待。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/9153 "When such a plugin fails, containerd will hang on the readiness condition"

lesson: 连续快速创建/启动大量容器，断言块设备在挂载前已就绪（与 udev 同步），不出现 no such file。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/10664 "Not being able to use udev leads to udev racing with devicemapper"

lesson: 外部 cloud provider 晚于 kubelet 设置不同的节点地址，断言 hostNetwork Pod 的 PodIPs 与最终节点地址一致。
evidence: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/121028 "undesired consequences if the cloud-provider addresses are different"

lesson: 对每种可选端口驱动跑一遍 -p 端口映射（含 IPv6 [::] 监听），防止重构只覆盖默认驱动。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/49514 "broken since ... (PR 48132, v28)"

lesson: 第一个镜像源持续返回 503，断言客户端回退到下一个镜像源而非直接失败。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/4575 "retry currently works only for 404"

lesson: 上游组件开始默认下发新字段（swap 限制），在不支持该能力的节点上启动容器，断言运行时忽略/降级而不失败。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/8857 "configured for container irrespective if the node supports swap"

lesson: 以非 root + no-new-privileges + cap_add 启动容器，断言 /proc/1/status 的 CapPrm/CapEff 包含所加能力，并与其它运行时对比。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/45511 "moby drops ep sets before the entrypoint is executed"

lesson: 在会对文件产生额外 CHMOD 事件的平台上 follow 日志，断言只输出新增行、不从头重读。
evidence: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/107634（未合并）"CHMOD of the file should not cause the kubelet to ... re-read"

lesson: 客户端不打开或中途关闭 stdio fifo，断言守护进程的 open 能被取消、其他 API（ps）不被阻塞。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/27405 "Fix issues with fifos blocking on open"

lesson: 并发 30+ 个短命 exec，测总耗时与串行对比，断言没有因全局锁导致的数量级退化，且 start/exit 事件顺序正确。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/8617 "eventSendMu is causing severe lock contention"

lesson: live-restore 打开时重启底层运行时守护进程，断言运行中的容器仍被识别为 running。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/6535 "It will be conflict if user wants to use BinaryName"

lesson: live-restore 后重启容器再删除其卷，断言卷的活跃挂载计数在恢复时被重建、卷可正常删除。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/45754 "the count is zero until the container stops and the uint64 overflows"

lesson: 节点重启后 shim socket 已不存在，断言守护进程对每个死 shim 快速失败并完成启动，启动时长不随容器数线性放大。
evidence: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/5648 "Do not tolerate ENOENT while reconnecting shim socket"; merged fix PR 6031
"nothing explains what the expected semantics of an FQDN slice are"（文档/弃用）

lesson: 在写入层内容中途注入失败，断言 writer 句柄关闭、层可被 prune 删除、磁盘回收量与报告一致。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/36728 "LayerWriter was never closed in this case"

lesson: 用未启用 seccomp 构建标签的二进制运行 info，断言报告的安全能力同时考虑编译期与内核支持。
evidence: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/24468 "seccomp might not be enabled when building docker"
